Strategy: For tiny items under fifteen use worst fit so they spread across roomy bins, otherwise use Best Fit, keeping the sweet band and mid penalty. Tiny items fit almost anywhere so preserving tight bins matters, but the fifteen threshold is a guess and worst fit may waste space.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [((r - item) if item < 15 else -(r - item)) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
